hints.title: Target Value Determination
hints.text: The maximum possible bitwise value is achieved by taking the bitwise combine across all array elements.

hints.title: Branching Search
hints.text: Explore all subsets recursively or via iterative masking.

hints.title: Counting Satisfying Subsets
hints.text: Count every branch where the accumulated bitwise combination equals the target maximum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: The maximum bitwise combination is always the bitwise sum across all elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Subsets are exponentially large in general, but N <= 16 makes 2^16 trivially small.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursive branch pruning avoids deep exploration of subsets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that bitwise OR is monotonically non-decreasing.
